capture_plan.after_insertion: every native view is fetched again and copied after the operation; no pre-insertion AkaArray view is reused
capture_plan.connectivity_and_ancestry: capture rest nodes/bulk T4/cohesive connectivity in event snapshots; hash/count and run generic exact source-cell-row/local-corner ancestry on every sample; declare unchanged bulk-row assumption
capture_plan.every_A_and_B: capture state to memory; retain current A and a rolling four previous no-insertion B states; persist dense A/B/C only on a reported insertion step
capture_plan.every_C: capture only after a positive insertion delta; preserve appended node/mass/force values as pre-solve, potentially stale
capture_plan.every_D: capture all nodal displacement, velocity, acceleration, mass, internal/external force and blocked DOFs; bulk material stress; all cohesive fields; energies; scalar trace; snapshot-local ancestry check
capture_plan.normals: capture FacetsFEEngine native normals on pre-check candidate slots at B; capture cohesive internal `normal` after insertion; never infer cohesive orientation from MSH winding
capture_plan.preinsert_candidate_stress: capture only check-mask candidate rows from getStressOnFacets at B; preserve native slot and QP shape; no cross-insertion QP ordinal join
capture_plan.shape_maps: copy read-only public FEEngine getShapes for available T4/Tri3/cohesive types; actual wheel Python surface has no public integration-weight/Jacobian getter, so no nodal force reconstruction or fabricated QP weight ordering is allowed

comparison_outline: compare first insertion physical clock step*dt and stable facet identity set across h/h2/h4
compute q_first only where native cohesive opening, actual native normal, and frozen beta=3 metric are populated; report q_first/h^2; retain missing evidence as UNKNOWN
evaluate direction compatibility against native insertion-stress vector only after its field semantics are confirmed from the cached native law; do not create a circular reconstruction
reconstruct signed QP work and native cohesive energy changes only with snapshot-local field lineage and independently supported area/weight mapping; preserve signed increments
compare force, opening, history, native mass, and energy at matched physical times; never compare row/QP ordinals across insertion transitions
report frozen post-insertion tangent/eigenvalue diagnostics separately; they are not onset CFL certification

actual_interface_geometry.method: 0.5 * norm(cross(x1-x0, x2-x0)); no nominal rectangle area substituted
actual_interface_geometry.source: recomputed from frozen Gmsh 2.2 node coordinates and physical interface triangles

material_values_from_frozen_manifest.source_note: illustrative values also shown in official Akantu examples; not ceramic properties

launch_gate.exact_commands: README.md has the three currently planned h, h/2, h/4 commands and a separate h/8 root-confirmation gate; commands are emitted by --prepare

ledger_and_native_limitations.energy_ledger_pass: forbidden unless actual actuator force and prescribed kinematic phase are proven; otherwise report exact missing quantity and leave status UNKNOWN
ledger_and_native_limitations.mass: C mass/force arrays are captured but marked pre-solve potentially stale; D after solveStep is the operative candidate, not a mass pass by itself
ledger_and_native_limitations.native_insert_stress: capture native per-QP sigma_c_eff, delta_c_eff, insertion_stress, normal, opening, traction, contact opening/traction and damage; no sigma inferred from traction
ledger_and_native_limitations.prescribed_boundary_work: capture top displacement history, blocked DOFs, native internal/external forces and their phases; the top internal-reaction sign estimate remains an estimate, not a verified actuator force
ledger_and_native_limitations.weights: actual triangle areas come from frozen mesh coordinates; per-QP native integration weights are not exposed by the wheel's public Python FEEngine surface

native_call_order: addPhysicalSurface('interface'); updateAutomaticInsertion(); require 8 eligible and 0 inserted
apply zero-valued bottom z Dirichlet condition once
per step A getter capture; set ramp time=step*dt; applyBC(ramp,'top'); B getter capture
checkCohesiveStress(); capture return and native cohesive count delta
if insertion occurred, immediately refetch/copy all state for C; no force/mass assembly for observation
solveStep(); immediately refetch/copy D state; capture every D through the common endpoint

output_forecast.forecast_method: uncompressed D array payload plus explicit conservative fixed allowances; no compression ratio assumed
output_forecast.scope: worst-case 4-resolution envelope; h/8 remains root-gated and is not in the current three-run authorization request

phase_clock.driver_time: exact Decimal(step)*Decimal(dt), stored with binary64 dt and scheduled BC value
phase_clock.native_getTime: unavailable in actual wheel; never called or presented as measured
phase_clock.phase_A: before the current step's applyBC; native state is copied immediately at that phase
phase_clock.phase_B: after applyBC(step*dt), before checkCohesiveStress; bulk/facet stress are existing stress values
phase_clock.phase_C: immediately after checkCohesiveStress and any insertion, before solveStep; mass/force may be stale
phase_clock.phase_D: immediately after solveStep; no additional assembly before getters

provisional_numerical_screens.all_screens: numerical screens only; no physical calibration, material qualification, or onset CFL certificate

energy_defect.status: cannot be called PASS unless actuator work/kinematic phase and native energy ledger are independently verified

matched_history_difference.definition: normalized pairwise history difference at matched physical times on common endpoint; exact observable list and normalization frozen by offline audit before interpretation
